title: The aws-ebs-csi-driver Helm chart will stop supporting helm upgrade --reuse-values

detection.reason: how the chart is upgraded (and whether the EKS add-on manages it instead) is not visible in the cluster

quote: The EBS CSI Driver Helm chart will stop supporting `--reuse-values` in a future release
remediation: If the driver is installed with the aws-ebs-csi-driver Helm chart, stop upgrading with --reuse-values: from chart v2.29.0 the chart no longer supports it and upstream says such upgrades will likely fail (reused values skip every new chart default). Use --reset-then-reuse-values, or helm upgrade -f with the full values file. The EKS managed add-on is unaffected.
